blocking: Desktop celebration panels combine fixed height, overflow:hidden and unrestricted copy; expanded content can be clipped at narrower desktop widths or increased text size.
On phones, the motion control disappears after the hero although scroll-driven motion continues below it.

fixes.what: Let expanded panels grow to fit their text, or switch to the stacked layout whenever the available width or height cannot accommodate the body. Verify every panel at 200% text size.
fixes.why: Essential celebration descriptions must remain readable without clipping.

fixes.what: Keep the motion control available throughout mobile pages; use the stable accessible label 'Pause animations' with aria-pressed=true meaning paused.
fixes.why: Visitors need to stop motion where they encounter it, and 'Motion, pressed' does not clearly communicate the current state.

fixes.what: Remove the CSS translateX(102%) initialization and let GSAP exclusively set xPercent from 102 to 0, with x explicitly set to 0.
fixes.why: CSS translation and GSAP xPercent can compound, leaving the gold strips displaced at the animation endpoint.

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js — buildTweens block 8 and desktopQuery change handlers
fixes.what: Rebuild the leaf animations when crossing the 769px breakpoint, reverting the previous animation before creating its replacement.
fixes.why: Resizing currently preserves whichever infinite drift or scroll animation was selected at initial load.

fixes.what: Derive each dot's activation point from its actual position along the rendered track and recalculate after layout changes.
fixes.why: Equal index-based timing does not match unevenly spaced mobile steps, so dots change color before or after the drawn line reaches them.
